title: StellarAid npm Audit Allowlist
description: Documented and reviewed exceptions for unfixable npm advisories in @stellaraid/wallet-adapters
exception_process: See docs/STORAGE.md §9.4 for policy rules. Any waiver requires: 1) confirmation of unfixability without major breaking change, 2) non-exploitability justification in wallet adapter scope, 3) review and sign-off on PR.

allowlist.reason: Uncontrolled recursion in toml parser via @stellar/stellar-sdk 12.3.0. stellar.toml parsing is not invoked anywhere in @stellaraid/wallet-adapters runtime.
allowlist.remediation: Upgrade to stellar-sdk 17+ when breaking SDK changes are adopted workspace-wide.

allowlist.reason: Prototype pollution via toml parser in @stellar/stellar-sdk 12.3.0. Only reachable if untrusted TOML input is parsed, which wallet adapters do not do.
allowlist.remediation: Upgrade to stellar-sdk 17+ when breaking SDK changes are adopted workspace-wide.

allowlist.reason: Quadratic complexity DoS in toml parser via @stellar/stellar-sdk 12.3.0. Wallet adapters do not parse TOML.
allowlist.remediation: Upgrade to stellar-sdk 17+ when breaking SDK changes are adopted workspace-wide.

allowlist.reason: Quadratic complexity DoS via long dotted keys in toml parser via @stellar/stellar-sdk 12.3.0. Wallet adapters do not parse TOML.
allowlist.remediation: Upgrade to stellar-sdk 17+ when breaking SDK changes are adopted workspace-wide.

allowlist.reason: CPU DoS via unbounded-length integer literals in toml parser via @stellar/stellar-sdk 12.3.0. Wallet adapters do not parse TOML.
allowlist.remediation: Upgrade to stellar-sdk 17+ when breaking SDK changes are adopted workspace-wide.

allowlist.reason: Prototype pollution parsing TOML document in toml parser via @stellar/stellar-sdk 12.3.0. Wallet adapters do not parse TOML.
allowlist.remediation: Upgrade to stellar-sdk 17+ when breaking SDK changes are adopted workspace-wide.

allowlist.reason: Header bypass in follow-redirects via axios in @stellar/stellar-sdk 12.3.0. Wallet adapters do not follow cross-origin redirects with confidential headers.
allowlist.remediation: Bump transitive axios / follow-redirects in lockfile or upgrade stellar-sdk.

allowlist.reason: SensitiveHeaders regex escaping in follow-redirects via axios in @stellar/stellar-sdk 12.3.0.
allowlist.remediation: Bump transitive axios / follow-redirects in lockfile or upgrade stellar-sdk.

allowlist.reason: Cross-realm sensitiveHeaders array discarded in follow-redirects via axios in @stellar/stellar-sdk 12.3.0.
allowlist.remediation: Bump transitive axios / follow-redirects in lockfile or upgrade stellar-sdk.
